reviews.title: Hard to navigate
reviews.text:
It’s annoying to navigate. Why can’t we just have buttons to follow a player immediately on the Leaderboard?? 
It was so much easier to navigate last year’s App.
Also the Fantasy is asinine now, to have to sigh in to Fantasy separately outside the App into a browser. Such a hassle. 
Bring back how it was last year.
And you just put up an image saying the 2027 schedule is there but it isn’t. 
You’re losing people by slacking, LIV

reviews.title: Some issues, just needs dialed in.
reviews.text: Groups can you can’t hear the shots when they hit them, usually just some mic far away that has some birds chirping or whatever background noise is present. The other problem is that in multiview, closed caption is always on the main broadcast, and it covers the lower part of the screen and you can’t see the shots being hit or putts being holed. Those previous problems are on both mobile and tv app. As for just mobile, I can’t watch the broadcast in fullscreen, so it’s basically unusable.

reviews.title: Too Complicated
reviews.text:
I’ve paid for this for 2 years but will not renew. This should be simple to build in a way I don’t have to know who wins a tournament when I log in the app. Let me go to the event. Give my full round 1 and Round 1 highlights round 2 same round 3 same round 4 same. 

I’m trying to watch Adelaide. I log in and it ruins it and tells me who wins. I see recaps for the rounds but I can’t even find the last round I would like to watch. Just 59 other pointless videos. 

Not everyone can watch this live so we pay for an app and want to watch it later. Then you find new and interesting ways to ruin who wins and not be able to find the content I was paying for in the first place. Great job devs!

reviews.title: You don’t want to succeed do you?
reviews.text: I’ve been using LIV Golf Plus app since Bedminster 2022. It has been fantastic and is a huge reason I’m obsessed with golf the last few years. Finally caught up on 2024’s season (had to watch half of the season on YouTube because you wanted me to pay to watch last season?) and now you’ve lost me. I don’t have time to watch live as I work a lot, and I was totally okay with paying for the premium subscription. Even though “free” has been your thing since the beginning, it would be worth it. Except now I see you only have the entire final round on-demand for each event. Second round, highlights only? First round just not even gonna bother? I’m not paying for your premium subscription to just watch the final round of each event. You’ve failed your most loyal fans. Hopefully your numbers reflect this piss poor business decision.

reviews.title: Subscription to watch, Bye
reviews.text: I’ve watched numerous events on LIV from year one. Because like the Masters app, it was easy to watch anytime for free. The moment they made it a subscription, I’m out. This will be the end of LIV. May be a slow death, but it will eventually die. Duma**es shouldn’t have turned on your early fans. Bye

reviews.title: Lame
reviews.text: Not a good revamp of the app. First, no landscape support throughout the app on an iPad. I don’t really need it on my iPhone (other than for the video player), but I definitely want it on iPad. Second, it appears like you’re not following the Apple developer rules for app tracking. You need to abide by the user’s device settings for App Tracking; either ask the user if you can track, or don’t track. You can’t just track without checking the device settings. Fix these to things and maybe I’ll use the app.
